messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — vendor uploaded a partial manifest for the midweek shipment. It shows 8/12 H100s confirmed (rest "on hold"). @sam @ricardo can you confirm if 8 is usable for the dedicated-demo pool? invoice #INV-9123 https://vendor.example/manifest/9123

sam: Which pool exactly? dedicated-demo-east or the transient demo pool? also do we have serials so hw inventory can be pre-staged? :eyes:

vendor-bot: Shipping manifest uploaded by VendorX at 2024-10-09T14:02Z. File: https://vendor.example/manifest/9123
```
S/N,HARDWARE,STATUS
H100-0042,H100,CONFIRMED
H100-0043,H100,CONFIRMED
H100-0044,H100,CONFIRMED
H100-0045,H100,CONFIRMED
H100-0046,H100,CONFIRMED
H100-0047,H100,CONFIRMED
H100-0048,H100,CONFIRMED
H100-0049,H100,CONFIRMED
H100-0050,H100,ON_HOLD
H100-0051,H100,ON_HOLD
H100-0052,H100,ON_HOLD
H100-0053,H100,ON_HOLD
```

ricardo: If it's for dedicated-demo-east we can run the canary on 8 GPUs, but throughput predictability drops ~30% for our batch size distribution. We should request a temporary quota bump to 12 so we can do the full canary. Filing a quota ticket now (TICKET-4487).

lisa: For fallback, can we mix in some A100s from the demo pool instead of delaying? mixing will affect perf curve but might be faster than waiting on the rest of the H100s. @oncall any objections for a hybrid canary?

oncall: No objections. Hybrid canary ok if we constrain batch_size to 16 and max_tokens to 512 for the first 1h. Also we should enable prefix caching to reduce traffic. I'll coordinate the routing change.

sam: ok switching plan to hybrid if quota bump doesn't clear by 10:00 PT. Can someone drop a quick terraform snippet or PR to request the quota? I can review.

maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1298 — increases GPUs in eu-west dedicated-demo-east from 8->12 as temporary uplift. includes billing note referencing INV-9123. @eng-sre please review/merge if no blockers.

ricardo: FYI snippet for canary config (apply to canary route):
```yaml
route: canary/dedicated-demo-east
instances: 2
gpu_type: hybrid
batch_size: 16
max_tokens: 512
prefetch_cache: true
monitoring: latency,errors,token_cost
```

vendor-bot: Update from VendorX: remaining 4 units moved to "pre-shipment" with tentative ship date 2024-10-11. ETA to vendor hub: 2024-10-12.

maya: Sweet — action items: (1) @eng-sre merge PR #1298 or approve quota ticket TICKET-4487; (2) @sam deploy hybrid canary with ricardo's config if quota not in place by 10:00 PT; (3) vendor to confirm S/Ns on final shipment. I'll update the demo schedule and billing with INV-9123. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: ack, prepping the canary playbook now. :white_check_mark:

oncall: I'll take the routing change and add the temporary latency SLO guardrails.

lisa: I'll ping vendor contact for final serial confirmation and post here when I have them.

maya: Closing the loop — will follow up after PR/ticket status.
